meta.title: Token Usage Stats
meta.description: Daily, weekly, and monthly token usage in a bottom status bar, historical usage replayed from the Host's session logs, a current-session “Usage” tab in the conversation view, and per-project, per-session, and per-conversation breakdowns (cached vs uncached input, cache writes, output, and time), stored in an embedded SQLite database, plus a /tokenstats command and HTTP summary/breakdown routes.
